requirements: Coverage is mandatory
One release path, checked by code
contradictions.scenario: A review's coverage is not_run, unavailable, unusable or broken, and Dorian records a human exception. Coverage is mandatory says it can then reach released. One release path says review to released needs a clean, passing review at the merged head, and a merge with no passing review stays merged_unreviewed. SR-002.3 lists this as a known clash.
contradictions.smallest_change: State that a recorded human exception makes a non-checked-coverage review count as passing for review to released. Alternatively, drop the exception route and keep such items at merged_unreviewed.

requirements: The pre-merge gate is GitHub's, sized to the stakes
The pre-merge gate is GitHub's, sized to the stakes
contradictions.scenario: A goal pull request touches no CODEOWNERS path, for example on a product repository. 'Every other change merges with no human approval' and the ruleset's zero required approvals let it merge. The same constraint says a goal reaches main only through 'his approval of the goal pull request'.
contradictions.smallest_change: Say that a goal pull request needs Dorian's approving review at its head whatever paths it touches, and that this is the one exception to 'every other change merges with no human approval'. Or say goal pull requests always touch a goals/ or goal-runs/ path, which is a CODEOWNERS path.

contradictions.scenario: An item such as SR-002 (SR-002.8) is merged with a clean review. released to done is the only route to done, but vocab_check.py refuses released until B-a's first fix. The interim rule only covers items merged without review, which read 'review' with 'Merged unreviewed'. A properly reviewed merge has no valid status.
contradictions.smallest_change: Add an interim rule for reviewed merges. For example, they read 'review' with 'Released at <head>' in the status line until released joins the vocabulary. Or make adding released and merged_unreviewed to vocab_check.py a precondition for finishing any item.
